import {
  defineApp,
  Screen,
  Stack,
  Row,
  Card,
  Divider,
  Text,
  Button,
  ProgressBar,
  toast,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  storage,
  type SchemaArtifact,
} from 'vc-sdk';

const SCHEMA: SchemaArtifact = {
  schemaVersion: 1,
  collections: {},
};

const GOAL = 8; // glasses a day
const GLASS_ML = 250; // millilitres in one glass

// A local calendar stamp, so "today" ticks over at local midnight.
function dayStamp(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  const month = `${d.getMonth() + 1}`.padStart(2, '0');
  const day = `${d.getDate()}`.padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function mlLabel(ml: number): string {
  if (ml < 1000) return `${ml} ml`;
  const litres = ml / 1000;
  return `${Number.isInteger(litres) ? litres : litres.toFixed(1)} L`;
}

function Home() {
  const [glasses, setGlasses] = useState(0);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  // Read today's count once, when the app opens; a new day starts the count again.
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      const savedDay = await storage.kv.get('todayDate');
      const savedGlasses = await storage.kv.get('glassesToday');
      if (!live) return;
      const today = dayStamp();
      if (savedDay === today && typeof savedGlasses === 'number') {
        setGlasses(Math.max(0, Math.round(savedGlasses)));
      } else {
        setGlasses(0);
        await storage.kv.set('todayDate', today);
        await storage.kv.set('glassesToday', 0);
      }
      setReady(true);
    })().catch(() => {
      if (!live) return;
      setReady(true);
      toast('Couldn’t load today’s glasses.');
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const save = (next: number) => {
    setGlasses(next);
    storage.kv.set('todayDate', dayStamp()).catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save that.'));
    storage.kv.set('glassesToday', next).catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save that.'));
  };

  const addGlass = () => {
    const next = glasses + 1;
    save(next);
    toast(next === GOAL ? `Goal reached — ${GOAL} glasses today` : `Glass ${next} logged · ${GLASS_ML} ml`);
  };

  const undoGlass = () => {
    if (glasses === 0) return;
    const next = glasses - 1;
    save(next);
    toast(`Removed one glass · ${next} today`);
  };

  const reached = glasses >= GOAL;

  return (
    <Screen title="Water Counter">
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <ProgressBar
          variant="ring"
          value={Math.min(glasses / GOAL, 1)}
          tone={reached ? 'positive' : 'primary'}
          label={String(glasses)}
        />
        <Stack gap="xs">
          <Text align="center">{`${glasses} of ${GOAL} glasses today`}</Text>
          <Text align="center" size="caption" color="text-muted">
            {reached
              ? `${mlLabel(glasses * GLASS_ML)} logged — goal met`
              : `${mlLabel(glasses * GLASS_ML)} of ${mlLabel(GOAL * GLASS_ML)} · ${GOAL - glasses} to go`}
          </Text>
        </Stack>

        <Button label={`Log a glass (${GLASS_ML} ml)`} icon="glass-water" disabled={!ready} onPress={addGlass} />

        <Row>
          <Button label="Undo last glass" variant="secondary" icon="minus" disabled={glasses === 0} onPress={undoGlass} />
        </Row>

        <Card>
          <Stack>
            <Row justify="between">
              <Text color="text-muted">Glasses</Text>
              <Text>{`${glasses} / ${GOAL}`}</Text>
            </Row>
            <Row justify="between">
              <Text color="text-muted">Water so far</Text>
              <Text>{mlLabel(glasses * GLASS_ML)}</Text>
            </Row>
            <Divider />
            <Row justify="between">
              <Text color="text-muted">Daily goal</Text>
              <Text weight="semibold">{`${GOAL} glasses · ${mlLabel(GOAL * GLASS_ML)}`}</Text>
            </Row>
          </Stack>
        </Card>

        <Text size="caption" color="text-muted" align="center">
          Every glass counts {GLASS_ML} ml. The count starts fresh each day.
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

export default defineApp({
  name: 'Water Counter',
  initial: 'Home',
  screens: { Home },
  capabilities: ['storage'],
  schema: SCHEMA,
  tint: ['blue', 'ocean'],
  icon: 'glass-water',
});
